content: Quirishcamanda ali tucuna
Huauquiguna, israelguna quishpichishca tucunauchun nisha ñuca shungu ucumanda yapa munasha Dioshuan cuintani.
Ñáuca paigunamanda yachasha rimani. Paigunaga Diosta yapa sirbinchimi nishallata mana yachashcacuinta raungunami.
Dios paigunata paihuan ali ranata mana yachashcamandami paiguna rashcagunallahuanmi ali tucunata munashcauna. Chasna asha Dios paigunata ali ranata mana munashcamanda mana cadsuc anaushca.
Cristo huañusha chi mandashcagunata anchuchira tucui paita quiric runa Dioshuan ali tucuchun nisha.
Chi mandashcagunata cadsushcamanda Dioshuan ali tucungahua Moises casna quillcashca: Maican runa Dios mandashcagunata pactachishaga chimandami causanga.
Astahuanbas quirishcamanda Dioshuan ali tucungahua Diospa shimi casnami nin: Camba shungu ucui ama yuyaringuichu pita jahuapachama ringa Cristota ñucanchihuagma uraicuchingahua nisha.
Chasnallata pita huañushcagunama ringa Cristota huañushcamanda causachingahua nisha ama yuyaringuichichu.

Chasna yuyarina randimanda casna quillcashcata yuyarichi: Ñáucanchi camachishca shimiga Jesucristota quirinami nisha yachachinchimi, Diospa shimiga mana caruichu, camba mayanbimi, camba shimi ucuimi, camba shungu ucuimi tiyan, ninmi.
Chimanda camba shimihuan Jesusca ñuca mandac amu man nishaga, Dios paita huañushcamanda cuti causachishcata camba shunguhuan quirishaga quishpichishca tucunguimi.
Yuyarichi. Camba shunguhuan sirtu quirishami Dioshuan alichishca tucungui, camba shimihuan Cristoga ñucata mandac amu man nisha rimashami quishpichishca tucungui.
Chasnallata Diospa shimi casna ninmi: Maican paita quiric runaga mana pingachishcachu tucunga.
Israel runaguna mana-israel runagunahuas Diospacpi shuglla manaun. Jesucristoga tucui runagunata mandac amu asha tucui paita mañaccunata ashcata cunmi.
Diospa shimi chasnallata nin:
Astahuan runaguna paita chara mana quirishaga imasata mañangauna. Paimanda chara mana uyaccunaga imasata quiringauna. Yachachic runa illacpiga imasata uyangauna.
Yachachic runagunata mana cachashca acpiga imasata camachingahua ringauna. Chimandami Diospa shimibi casna nin: Diospa ali shimita yachachingahua purinaga yapa ali man ninmi.
Chasna agllaita mana tucui israelguna chi ali quishpina shimita uyashallata mana cadsunaurachu. Paigunamanda huañuc Isaiaspas rimashca: Mana tucui runa ñucanchi yachachishcata quiringaunachu Dios.
Chasna nigllaita quishpichic Cristomanda yachachishcata uyashcahuashami quirinata ushanaun.
Chasnamanda casna tapuni, manachu Diospa shimita yachachishcata rinrihuan uyashcauna. Indá uyashcaunami. Diospa shimi casna nin:
Chasnallata cuti tapuni, israelguna rinrihuan uyasha manachu ali yachashcauna. Indá, ñaupa causac Moisesca Dios rimashcata casnami nishca:
Chihuasha huañuc Isaiaspas mana manzhasha Dios rimashcata casna quillcashca:
Maspas israelmanda Dios rimashcata Isaias casna quillcashca:
